CustomField.description: Revenue Cloud stores start at 00:00:00 UTC and end at 23:59:59 UTC (older assets at Chicago midnight), which America/Chicago users see as the previous day. Shifts 12 hours toward mid-day and reads the UTC date via TEXT(), since DATEVALUE(datetime) uses the viewing user's time zone.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calendar date of the period, shown without a time so it does not shift to the previous day in the user's time zone.
CustomField.label: Period End
